## Why visit

A rewarding small traditional pub on an easy route between the station and city centre. The appeal is pub culture at close quarters: conversation, games including bagatelle, an open fire in colder weather and a changing cask range. It is a useful counterweight to Chester’s larger dining pubs and specialist bars. Choose it if you want to spend an unhurried hour in a local rather than inspect a landmark room. The surviving etched brewery windows and older fittings add interest, but the day-to-day welcome and beer are the main reasons to stop.
